game2.status: Game over (MLB Stats API status 'Game Over' at 10:49 PM CT; listed as final pending official 'Final' tag)
moments: The Rays scored four in the top of the first. Liam Hicks hit a two-run homer, the first homer of the Series.
The Brewers got two back right away in the bottom of the first on RBI singles by William Contreras and Garrett Mitchell.
Sal Frelick tied it 4-4 with a solo homer in the sixth. Cooper Pratt's RBI single in the seventh put Milwaukee ahead 5-4.
Aaron Ashby stranded the tying run at third in the ninth with two strikeouts to end it.
